subtitle: Multi-rail strategy is a routing engine, a liquidity book, and an ISO 20022 translator stacked above the legacy core. Architects who treat it as a product launch will fund three rails and operate none of them well.
description: FedNow demands pre-funded 24/7 liquidity. ACH is cheap but T+1. USDC clears atomically but needs wallet infrastructure. The 2026 multi-rail bank routes each payment by cost, finality, and liquidity cost — driven by an orchestration engine that reads ISO 20022 pacs.008 and decides.
